SELECT f."School Type", f."School Name", s."latitude"
FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON s."cdscode" = f."cdscode"
WHERE (f."School Type" ILIKE '%Intermediate/Middle%' OR f."School Type" ILIKE '%Junior High%' OR f."School Name" ILIKE '%Middle%' OR f."School Name" ILIKE '%Junior High%')
  AND s."latitude" = (
    SELECT MAX(s2."latitude")
    FROM frpm f2 JOIN schools s2 ON s2."cdscode" = f2."cdscode"
    WHERE (f2."School Type" ILIKE '%Intermediate/Middle%' OR f2."School Type" ILIKE '%Junior High%' OR f2."School Name" ILIKE '%Middle%' OR f2."School Name" ILIKE '%Junior High%')
      AND s2."latitude" IS NOT NULL
  )
final.answer:
The northernmost middle school in California is Butte Valley Middle, at latitude 41.9642°. Its School Type is "Junior High Schools (Public)". It is open (no closed date). No other middle school ties with it; the next northernmost is Crescent Elk Middle at 41.7563°.

WITH acc_avg AS (
  SELECT account_id, AVG(balance) AS avg_bal FROM "trans" GROUP BY account_id
),
holders AS (
  SELECT cl."gender", a."account_id", a."district_id"
  FROM "card" c
  JOIN "disp" d ON c."disp_id" = d."disp_id"
  JOIN "client" cl ON d."client_id" = cl."client_id"
  JOIN "account" a ON d."account_id" = a."account_id"
  JOIN acc_avg aa ON aa.account_id = a."account_id"
  WHERE aa.avg_bal > 1000 AND cl."gender" IN ('F','M')
),
dist AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT h."gender", di."district_id", di."a2", CAST(di."a4" AS bigint) AS inhabitants, di."a11", di."a10"
  FROM holders h JOIN "district" di ON di."district_id" = h."district_id"
  WHERE CAST(di."a4" AS bigint) > 100000
)
SELECT gender,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dist d2 WHERE d2.gender = d.gender) AS n_districts,
  a2, district_id, inhabitants,
  ROUND((SELECT AVG(a11) FROM dist d3 WHERE d3.gender = d.gender)::numeric, 2) AS avg_salary,
  ROUND((SELECT AVG(a10) FROM dist d4 WHERE d4.gender = d.gender)::numeric, 2) AS avg_urban_ratio
FROM dist d
WHERE inhabitants = (SELECT MAX(inhabitants) FROM dist d5 WHERE d5.gender = d.gender)
ORDER BY gender, district_id

WITH base AS (
  SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date, cd.type AS card_type,
         EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cd.issued)::int - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM c.birth_date)::int AS age_at_issue,
         a.account_id, c.district_id
  FROM card cd
  JOIN disp d ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id
  JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM cd.issued) = 1994
),
loans AS (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS loan_count, SUM(amount) AS total_amount
  FROM loan GROUP BY account_id
)
SELECT b.client_id, b.gender, b.birth_date, b.card_type, b.age_at_issue,
       COALESCE(l.loan_count,0) AS loan_count,
       COALESCE(l.total_amount,0) AS total_amount,
       CASE WHEN COALESCE(l.loan_count,0) >= 1 AND b.age_at_issue < 30 THEN 'Young borrower'
            WHEN COALESCE(l.loan_count,0) >= 1 AND b.age_at_issue >= 30 THEN 'Mature borrower'
            ELSE 'Non-borrower' END AS borrower_class,
       b.district_id,
       RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY b.gender ORDER BY b.age_at_issue) AS age_rank_in_gender
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN loans l ON l.account_id = b.account_id
ORDER BY b.client_id;

)
SELECT t.loan_id, t.amount, t.duration, ROUND((t.payments*t.duration)::numeric,2) AS total_payments,
  ROUND((t.payments*t.duration - t.amount)::numeric,2) AS interest_paid, t.status,
  a.district_id, di.a2 AS district_name, di.a3 AS region,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trans tr WHERE tr.account_id=t.account_id) AS trans_count,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM loan l2 JOIN account a2 ON a2.account_id=l2.account_id JOIN district d2 ON d2.district_id=a2.district_id WHERE d2.a3=di.a3) AS region_loans,
  (SELECT ROUND(AVG(d3.a11)::numeric,2) FROM district d3 WHERE d3.a3=di.a3) AS region_avg_salary,
  d.client_id, c.birth_date,
  DATE_PART('year', AGE(DATE '2026-10-09', c.birth_date))::int AS age_2026_10_09
FROM top3 t
JOIN account a ON a.account_id=t.account_id
JOIN district di ON di.district_id=a.district_id
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id=t.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id=d.client_id

WITH wd AS (
  SELECT a."district_id", SUM(t."amount")::numeric AS total_wd
  FROM "trans" t JOIN "account" a ON t."account_id" = a."account_id"
  GROUP BY a."district_id"
),
so AS (
  SELECT a."district_id", SUM(o."amount"::numeric) AS so_total
  FROM "order" o JOIN "account" a ON o."account_id" = a."account_id"
  GROUP BY a."district_id"
),
ac AS (
  SELECT "district_id", COUNT(*) AS n FROM "account" GROUP BY "district_id"
),
base AS (
  SELECT d."a2" AS district_name, d."a3" AS region, d."a4"::bigint AS population,
         wd.total_wd,
         ROUND(wd.total_wd / d."a4"::bigint, 2) AS wd_per_inh,
         ROUND(COALESCE(so.so_total, 0) / ac.n, 2) AS avg_so
  FROM "district" d
  JOIN wd ON wd."district_id" = d."district_id"
  JOIN ac ON ac."district_id" = d."district_id"
  LEFT JOIN so ON so."district_id" = d."district_id"
  WHERE d."a4"::bigint >= 100000
)
SELECT split_part(district_name, ' [', 1) AS district_name, region, population, total_wd, wd_per_inh,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY wd_per_inh DESC) AS rnk, avg_so
FROM base
ORDER BY rnk, district_name

  FROM "trans" t JOIN "account" a ON t."account_id" = a."account_id"
  GROUP BY a."district_id"
),
so AS (
  SELECT a."district_id", SUM(o."amount"::numeric) AS so_total
  FROM "order" o JOIN "account" a ON o."account_id" = a."account_id"
  GROUP BY a."district_id"
),
ac AS (
  SELECT "district_id", COUNT(*) AS n FROM "account" GROUP BY "district_id"
),
base AS (
  SELECT d."a2" AS district_name, d."a3" AS region, d."a4"::bigint AS population,
         wd.total_wd,
         ROUND(wd.total_wd / d."a4"::bigint, 2) AS wd_per_inh,
         ROUND(COALESCE(so.so_total, 0) / ac.n, 2) AS avg_so
  FROM "district" d
  JOIN wd ON wd."district_id" = d."district_id"
  JOIN ac ON ac."district_id" = d."district_id"
  LEFT JOIN so ON so."district_id" = d."district_id"
  WHERE d."a4"::bigint >= 100000
),
r AS (
SELECT district_name, region, population, total_wd, wd_per_inh,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY wd_per_inh DESC) AS rnk, avg_so
FROM base)
SELECT * FROM r ORDER BY rnk, district_name OFFSET 20

WITH ev AS (SELECT "event_id", "type" FROM "event" WHERE "event_date" LIKE '2019-%'),
att AS (SELECT e."type", COUNT(DISTINCT a."link_to_member") AS n FROM ev e JOIN "attendance" a ON a."link_to_event" = e."event_id" GROUP BY e."type"),
bud AS (SELECT e."type", SUM(b."amount") AS amt FROM ev e JOIN "budget" b ON b."link_to_event" = e."event_id" GROUP BY e."type")
SELECT t."type", COALESCE(att.n, 0) AS members_attended, COALESCE(bud.amt, 0) AS total_budgeted
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "type" FROM ev) t
LEFT JOIN att ON att."type" = t."type"
LEFT JOIN bud ON bud."type" = t."type"
ORDER BY t."type"
